caseTitle.en: The tummy ache he couldn't name

title.en: A day in the children's ER

tagline.zh: 肚子痛的男孩，也要看睪丸
tagline.en: A boy with tummy pain gets his testes examined too

desc.zh: 兒童急診的外科會診。肚子痛的孩子一個接一個，有的要等，有的一分鐘都不能等。
desc.en: The surgical consult in the children's ER. One tummy ache after another; some can wait, some can't wait a minute.

desc.zh: 泡泡水、繪本、一隻布偶。妳讓孩子知道接下來會發生什麼，害怕就少一半。
desc.en: Bubbles, picture books, a puppet. You tell children what is about to happen, and half the fear goes.

role.zh: 小兒外科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 跟小孩說話一定蹲下來。口頭禪：「肚子痛的男孩，也要看睪丸。」
about.en: Always crouches to talk to children. Catchphrase: 'A boy with tummy pain gets his testes examined too.'

about.zh: 口袋有泡泡水和一本貼紙書。能讓任何孩子在打針時數到二十。
about.en: Bubbles and a sticker book in her pockets. Can get any child counting to twenty through a needle.

about.zh: 國一，籃球打到一半肚子痛、吐了兩次。只說肚子痛，其他什麼都不肯說。
about.en: First year of junior high; pain started mid-basketball and he vomited twice. Says only 'my tummy', nothing more.

about.zh: 開計程車，車停在急診門口沒熄火。一直問是不是吃壞肚子。
about.en: Taxi driver; left the cab running outside the ER. Keeps asking if it's something he ate.

about.zh: 肚子痛從肚臍跑到右下面，連最愛的布丁都不想吃。
about.en: Pain moved from her belly button to the lower right; she doesn't even want her favourite pudding.

about.zh: 護理師，自己知道太多，所以更怕。
about.en: A nurse herself; knows too much, which makes it scarier.

about.zh: 只在電話裡。產房打來找小兒外科，從來不是小事。
about.en: Only on the phone. When labour ward rings paediatric surgery, it's never small.

about.zh: 夜裡的電話。描述哭聲的方式比任何人都準。
about.en: The night phone. Describes a baby's cry more precisely than anyone.

plain.zh: 睪丸繞著自己的血管轉了圈，血流被勒住。幾個小時內就可能壞死，是男孩最急的急症之一。
plain.en: The testis twists on its own blood supply and strangles it. It can die within hours; one of the most urgent emergencies in boys.

plain.zh: 輕刮大腿內側，同側睪丸會往上提。睪丸扭轉時這個反射常常消失。
plain.en: Stroking the inner thigh makes the testis on that side lift. In torsion the reflex is usually lost.

plain.zh: 睪丸沒有好好固定在陰囊裡，像鐘裡的擺錘一樣容易轉。通常兩邊都有，所以對側也要固定。
plain.en: The testis isn't anchored in the scrotum and hangs like the clapper in a bell, free to twist. Usually both sides, so the other side is fixed too.

plain.zh: 把睪丸縫在陰囊內壁上，讓它以後不會再轉。
plain.en: Stitching the testis to the inside of the scrotum so it cannot twist again.

plain.zh: 闌尾發炎。典型是從肚臍附近痛到右下腹、不想吃、發燒。小小孩說不清楚，更容易破。
plain.en: Inflammation of the appendix. Classically pain moving from the belly button to the lower right, loss of appetite and fever. Young children can't describe it well and perforate more often.

plain.zh: 發炎的闌尾破了，膿流到肚子裡。發高燒、全肚子痛，可能變成敗血症。
plain.en: The inflamed appendix bursts and pus spills into the abdomen. High fever, pain everywhere, and it can turn into sepsis.

plain.zh: 感染讓全身的反應失控，影響血壓與器官。越早給抗生素、輸液和處理源頭越好。
plain.en: Infection driving the whole body's response out of control, affecting blood pressure and organs. The earlier the antibiotics, fluids and source control, the better.

plain.zh: 用遊戲、說明和陪伴，幫孩子面對檢查與手術的專業人員。孩子懂得越多，越不怕。
plain.en: A professional who uses play, explanation and company to help children through tests and operations. The more they understand, the less afraid they are.

plain.zh: 新生兒肚子凹下去像小船。腸子跑到胸腔裡去了，是橫膈疝氣的線索。
plain.en: A newborn's belly sunken like a little boat, because the bowel has gone up into the chest: a clue to diaphragmatic hernia.

plain.zh: 用面罩加球把空氣擠進肺。橫膈疝氣的寶寶不用，因為空氣會灌進胸腔裡的腸胃，把肺壓得更扁。
plain.en: Squeezing air into the lungs through a mask and bag. Not used in diaphragmatic hernia: the air fills the bowel in the chest and squashes the lungs further.

plain.zh: 一種放到胃裡、接持續抽吸的管子，把胃腸的空氣抽掉，讓肺有空間。
plain.en: A tube placed in the stomach on continuous suction, drawing air out of the gut so the lungs have room.

plain.zh: 一段腸子套進下一段裡，像收起來的望遠鏡。嬰幼兒陣發性大哭、縮腳、精神變差，晚期有果醬樣血便。
plain.en: One piece of bowel telescopes into the next. Infants have bouts of screaming with legs drawn up and become listless; redcurrant-jelly stool comes late.

text.zh: 孩子的闌尾和腸套疊，第一個檢查就是它：沒有輻射、可以邊玩邊照。
text.en: First test for a child's appendix or intussusception: no radiation, and it can be done while they play.

text.zh: 小安的工具。吹泡泡的時候要慢慢吐氣，孩子就自然放鬆了。
text.en: An's tool. Blowing bubbles means breathing out slowly, and children relax without noticing.

text.zh: 他手術後問的第一件事：下個月的比賽還能不能打。可以。
text.en: His first question after surgery: can he play next month's game? Yes.

text.zh: 放在病房冰箱，上面貼著她的名字。手術後第一個想吃的東西。
text.en: In the ward fridge with her name on it. The first thing she wants after surgery.

name.en: Tummy pain in a boy: examine the testes

text.zh: 青春期男孩睪丸扭轉時，常常只說肚子痛、想吐，因為不好意思，也因為痛會往下腹傳。所以每一位肚子痛的男孩都要檢查陰囊：腫、痛、位置偏高、橫躺、提睪反射消失，就當睪丸扭轉。拉上簾子、說明原因、尊重隱私。
text.en: Adolescent boys with torsion often say only 'tummy ache' and feel sick: they're embarrassed, and the pain is felt low in the abdomen. So every boy with abdominal pain has his scrotum examined: swollen, tender, riding high, lying horizontally, no cremasteric reflex means torsion. Curtain closed, reason explained, privacy respected.

text.zh: 睪丸扭轉越早解開，保住的機會越高；拖過幾個小時，壞死的機會快速上升。臨床高度懷疑時直接手術探查，不要為了等超音波而延誤。手術時解開扭轉、觀察顏色，有活力就固定，同時固定對側。
text.en: The sooner a torsion is untwisted, the better the chance of saving the testis; after a few hours the odds fall fast. With strong clinical suspicion, explore surgically; never delay for an ultrasound. At operation: untwist, watch the colour, fix it if viable, and fix the other side too.

name.zh: 橫膈疝氣：不壓球、先插管

text.zh: 出生時呼吸困難、舟狀腹、心音偏右，要想到先天性橫膈疝氣。面罩甦醒球會把空氣打進胸腔裡的腸胃，所以直接插管、放雙腔抽吸管接抽吸，溫和通氣，看右手的血氧。
text.en: Breathing difficulty at birth, a scaphoid abdomen and heart sounds shifted to the right suggest congenital diaphragmatic hernia. A bag and mask pumps air into the gut in the chest, so: intubate straight away, Replogle tube on suction, gentle ventilation, watch the right-hand saturation.

note.zh: 今天的規則：每個男孩都要看

lines.zh: 兒童急診的外科會診，九成是肚子痛。你要學會分出哪一個不能等。
lines.en: Nine in ten surgical consults in the children's ER are tummy aches. Learn to spot the one that can't wait.

lines.zh: 還有，進去之前先跟孩子說你要做什麼。我會在旁邊。
lines.en: And before you go in, tell the child what you're going to do. I'll be right there.

lines.zh: 記一句：肚子痛的男孩，也要看睪丸。
lines.en: Remember one line: a boy with tummy pain gets his testes examined too.

note.en: A-chun: the place he couldn't say

lines.zh: 早上打籃球突然肚子痛，吐了兩次。是不是吃壞肚子？
lines.en: He got tummy pain playing basketball this morning, vomited twice. Something he ate?

lines.zh: ……就肚子。下面。
lines.en: ...just my tummy. Lower down.

lines.zh: 阿駿，我要檢查肚子，也要檢查下面。我們拉上簾子，爸爸在外面等一下好嗎？
lines.en: A-chun, I need to check your tummy and also lower down. We'll close the curtain; could your dad wait outside a moment?

lines.zh: 阿駿，醫師會檢查你的睪丸，因為那裡痛也常常會覺得是肚子痛。這很常見，醫師每天都在看。
lines.en: A-chun, the doctor will check your testicles, because pain there often feels like tummy pain. It's really common; doctors check every day.

lines.zh: ……其實左邊那裡很痛。我不敢說。
lines.en: ...actually it really hurts down there on the left. I didn't want to say.

lines.zh: 謝謝你告訴我們。說出來是很勇敢的事。
lines.en: Thank you for telling us. Saying it is really brave.

lines.zh: 左側陰囊腫、紅、很痛，睪丸位置偏高、橫躺。左側提睪反射消失。
lines.en: Left hemiscrotum swollen, red and very tender; the testis rides high and lies horizontally. Left cremasteric reflex absent.

lines.zh: 痛了大概三個小時。這是睪丸扭轉，直到證明不是。
lines.en: About three hours of pain. This is testicular torsion until proven otherwise.

lines.zh: 痛三小時、睪丸偏高、反射消失。下一步？
lines.en: Three hours of pain, high-riding testis, reflex gone. Next step?

q.zh: 高度懷疑睪丸扭轉，痛了三小時，下一步？
q.en: Strongly suspected torsion, three hours of pain: next?

options.zh: 通知手術室，直接手術探查
options.en: Call theatre, go straight to exploration

why.zh: 對。臨床高度懷疑就探查，不為了超音波延誤。時間就是睪丸。
why.en: Right. Strong clinical suspicion means exploration, not a delay for ultrasound. Time is testis.

options.zh: 先排都卜勒超音波確認
options.en: Book a Doppler ultrasound to confirm

why.zh: 超音波可以幫忙，但不能讓它延誤手術。排隊的每一分鐘，睪丸都在缺血。
why.en: Ultrasound can help, but must never delay surgery. Every minute in the queue, the testis is starving.

options.zh: 止痛、觀察，痛退了就回家
options.en: Painkillers, observe, home if it settles

why.zh: 痛退了可能是睪丸已經壞死，不是好了。
why.en: Pain settling can mean the testis has died, not that it's better.

post.zh: 開刀？不是吃壞肚子？……好，車我先去停好。
post.en: An operation? Not something he ate? ...OK. Let me go and park the cab.

note.en: Untwist, wait for colour, fix both sides

lines.zh: 超音波排了四十分鐘，結果是左側沒有血流。卓主治已經在手術室等。
lines.en: Forty minutes waiting for ultrasound: no blood flow on the left. Dr Cho is already waiting in theatre.

lines.zh: 超音波證明了你早就知道的事，代價是四十分鐘。
lines.en: The scan proved what you already knew, at the cost of forty minutes.

lines.zh: 偏高、橫躺、反射消失，這不是觀察的病。出院單我撕了，手術室已經通知。
lines.en: High, horizontal, reflex gone: that isn't one to observe. I've torn up the discharge form, and theatre is ready.

lines.zh: ……我只看了他痛不痛，沒看那些徵象代表什麼。
lines.en: ...I only looked at whether he was in pain, not what the signs meant.

lines.zh: 切開以後怎麼做？順序。
lines.en: Once we're in, what do we do? In order.

q.zh: 睪丸扭轉探查手術的順序

steps.en: Open the scrotum, deliver the testis

steps.zh: 有活力就固定，壞死則切除
steps.en: Fix if viable, remove if dead

post.zh: 左睪丸轉了兩圈半，暗紫色。溫紗布下幾分鐘，慢慢變粉紅。兩側都做了睪丸固定術。
post.en: The left testis had turned two and a half times, dusky purple. Under warm swabs it slowly pinks up. Orchidopexy on both sides.

post.zh: 鐘擺畸形通常兩邊都有，那邊以後也可能轉。
post.en: The bell-clapper deformity is usually on both sides; that one could twist too.

lines.zh: 左邊轉了兩圈半，解開以後顏色回來了，兩邊都固定好，以後不會再轉。
lines.en: The left side had twisted two and a half times. Untwisted, the colour came back, and both sides are fixed so it can't happen again.

lines.zh: ……他從小什麼都不說，我也沒問。原來不是吃壞肚子。
lines.en: ...he's never said much since he was little, and I never asked. So it wasn't something he ate.

lines.zh: 他今天說了，而且說得剛好來得及。
lines.en: He said it today, and just in time.

lines.zh: 計程車還是沒熄火。我去熄一下，再回來陪他。
lines.en: The cab's still running. I'll switch it off and come back to sit with him.

note.zh: 沒有產前診斷的橫膈疝氣

sub.zh: 剛出生，發紺、肚子凹下去

lines.zh: 足月男嬰剛出生，一直發紺。肚子凹下去，心音在右邊。新生兒科在插管，他們要你來。
lines.en: Term boy just born, staying blue. Sunken belly, heart sounds on the right. Neonatology is intubating; they want you.

lines.zh: 舟狀腹、心音偏右，可能是橫膈疝氣。不要用面罩甦醒球！我馬上到。
lines.en: Scaphoid abdomen, heart sounds on the right: likely diaphragmatic hernia. No bag-mask ventilation! On my way.

lines.zh: 插好管了。下一步，放什麼管、為什麼？
lines.en: He's intubated. Next: which tube goes in, and why?

post.zh: 雙腔抽吸管接持續抽吸，把胸腔裡腸胃的空氣抽掉，肺才有空間。
post.en: A Replogle tube on continuous suction, to draw the air out of the gut in the chest so the lungs have room.

post.zh: 對。剩下的交給新生兒科的溫和通氣。修補不急，穩定才急。
post.en: Right. The rest is neonatology's gentle ventilation. The repair isn't urgent; stability is.

note.zh: 芊芊：痛從肚臍跑到右下
note.en: Chien-chien: pain moved from navel to lower right

lines.zh: 我不要打針！
lines.en: I don't want a needle!

lines.zh: 我們來吹泡泡比賽。吹很慢很慢的泡泡，看誰的最大。護理師在手上弄的時候，你就繼續吹。
lines.en: Let's have a bubble race. Blow really, really slowly and see whose is biggest. Keep blowing while the nurse does your hand.

lines.zh: ……我的比較大。
lines.en: ...mine's bigger.

lines.zh: 我是護理師，我知道闌尾炎會破。拜託快一點。
lines.en: I'm a nurse; I know appendicitis can burst. Please hurry.

lines.zh: 孩子的闌尾，第一個影像是什麼？為什麼？
lines.en: For a child's appendix, which imaging first, and why?

question.zh: 兒童懷疑闌尾炎，為什麼先做超音波？要看什麼？
question.en: Suspected appendicitis in a child: why ultrasound first, and what do you look for?

answer.zh: 沒有輻射、可以馬上做。看右下腹：壓不扁、變粗的闌尾，周圍脂肪發炎變亮、有沒有糞石、積液或膿瘍。看不到闌尾時，回到臨床評估與追蹤。
answer.en: No radiation, and it's quick. In the lower right: a thickened appendix that won't compress, bright inflamed fat around it, an appendicolith, fluid or abscess. If the appendix isn't seen, go back to clinical assessment and observation.

post.zh: 右下腹一條變粗、壓不扁的闌尾，尖端旁邊有一小片積液。
post.en: A thickened, non-compressible appendix in the lower right, with a small collection by its tip.

lines.zh: 她發抖得好厲害，摸起來好燙！
lines.en: She's shaking so hard and she's burning up!

lines.zh: 高燒、心跳很快，全肚子都痛，不讓人碰。
lines.en: High fever, racing pulse, pain all over her belly; she won't let anyone touch it.

options.zh: 抽血培養、依醫囑輸液抗生素、通知手術
options.en: Cultures, fluids and antibiotics per protocol, alert theatre

why.zh: 對。闌尾可能穿孔、走向敗血症。培養、輸液、抗生素同時進行，盡快手術處理源頭。
why.en: Right. The appendix has probably perforated and she's heading for sepsis. Cultures, fluids and antibiotics together, then surgery to control the source.

options.en: Bring the fever down, reassess later

why.zh: 退燒藥讓數字好看，不會處理肚子裡的膿。
why.en: Antipyretics improve the number; they do nothing about the pus inside.

why.zh: 診斷已經有了。敗血症的孩子不等更多影像。
why.en: The diagnosis is made. A septic child doesn't wait for more images.

lines.zh: 鏡頭先看全肚子，膿吸乾淨，再找闌尾根部。你來掌鏡頭和抓鉗。
lines.en: Survey the whole abdomen first, suck out the pus, then find the base. You're on camera and grasper.

post.zh: 闌尾尖端破了，周圍一小攤膿。根部完整。闌尾切除、腹腔沖洗。
post.en: The tip has burst, a small pool of pus around it. The base is sound. Appendix out, abdomen washed.

lines.zh: 我每天照顧別人的小孩，今天才知道家屬在外面有多難熬。
lines.en: I look after other people's children every day. Only today do I know how hard it is out here.

lines.zh: 她進去前說，布丁要留給出來的自己。
lines.en: Before she went in, she said the pudding's for herself when she comes out.

sub.zh: 9 個月大，一陣一陣大哭、縮腳
sub.en: Nine months old, screaming in bouts, legs drawn up

lines.zh: 九個月男嬰，每隔一陣子突然大哭、腳縮起來，中間很累很安靜。吐了兩次，剛剛尿布有一點紅紅黏黏的。
lines.en: Nine-month-old boy: every so often he suddenly screams and draws his legs up, then lies tired and quiet. Vomited twice; just now some red, sticky stuff in the nappy.

lines.zh: 要想到腸套疊。先超音波找標靶狀的腸子；沒有腹膜炎、生命徵象穩，就安排灌腸復位，我們外科待命。
lines.en: Think intussusception. Ultrasound for a target-shaped loop; if there's no peritonitis and he's stable, arrange an enema reduction with us on standby.

lines.zh: 收到。他媽媽說他今天特別黏人。
lines.en: Got it. His mum says he's been especially clingy today.

lines.zh: 今天四個孩子，四種痛：說不出口的、還沒出生就有的、從肚臍跑掉的、一陣一陣的。
lines.en: Four children, four kinds of pain today: the one he couldn't say, the one there before birth, the one that wandered from the navel, and the one that comes in waves.

lines.zh: 最重要的是早上那一個。你拉上簾子、說清楚，他才肯說左邊痛。
lines.en: The most important was this morning's. You closed the curtain and explained, so he told you it was the left side.

lines.zh: 是小安先說的。
lines.en: An said it first.

lines.zh: 值班未完。病房冰箱裡，布丁還在，上面多貼了一張「加油」。
lines.en: The night goes on. In the ward fridge the pudding waits, with a new note stuck on top: 'You can do it.'

sub.zh: 肚子痛的男孩，也要看睪丸
sub.en: A boy with tummy pain: examine the testes
